title: Fouche saw the TR3B twice
summary: UAPGerb tells of Fouche saw the TR3B twice, about 1990s at Edwards Air Force Base, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he Fuchche himself stated he had seen uh the craft twice. Once in Edwards Air Force Base and once somewhere else

plain: An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb, on Jesse Michels' podcast, relays a claim by Edgar Fouche, a man who spoke at a 1998 UFO conference about secret aircraft. According to UAPGerb, Fouche said he saw the TR3B, a rumoured secret triangle-shaped craft, twice in the 1990s, once at Edwards Air Force Base, a US military flight test site, and once somewhere else. If true, it would mean the US military flies craft it has never admitted to.
